description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 015 show a modern house jali design: the product photo has a square-grid terracotta jali facade wrapping a courtyard of a contemporary home, suited to elevations, courtyards and stair cores in new builds.

## How it looks
The grid is clean and regular, so the clay reads as a modern screen rather than an ornate one. Set against plain walls and glass, the terracotta adds warmth and texture, and the courtyard behind stays private while light filters through. This is the look many architects in Pakistan now use to cut glare on sun-facing sides.

## Where it works
- **Courtyard jali screen** that keeps an inner court private from the street.
- **Square grid jali elevation** on a west or south face to cut direct sun.
- **Contemporary clay jali** around a stair core or service balcony to hide clutter.

Fired clay tends to soak up less heat on its surface than glass and keeps a building looking warm, which is part of why jali screens are popular again in hot Pakistani cities.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Design: square-grid jali facade around a modern house courtyard (from the product photo)
- Material colour, block size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you order.

For a facade, ask your structural engineer how the screen will be tied back to the frame, and plan drip details so rain does not stain the wall below. Clean with water and a soft brush.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm, or ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your elevation drawing for a dated quote. Compare it with the [square grid facade jali](/products/terracotta-jali-tiles-001), read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or browse the [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of a modern house jali design?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the area of the screen, the design and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Is terracotta jali a good choice for a modern house front?
faqs.a: It often is. A plain square-grid jali gives a clean, contemporary elevation while shading windows and giving privacy; the fixing detail should come from your engineer.

faqs.q: Terracotta jali or cement jali for a modern facade?
faqs.a: Cement jali is grey and can be painted; terracotta jali keeps its natural clay colour without paint and tends to age with a warm patina.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 015" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
